Recorded claim:
Review clones are independent sibling clones, with `comm` nested below the Firefox clone. Cleanup aborts in-progress Git operations, hard-resets/cleans Review, force-prunes/synchronizes refs with `+refs/*:refs/*`, resets to the Working branch or detached hash, expires reflogs, runs GC, then mirrors Firefox `obj-*` and `mozconfig*` via copy-on-write where available. [Task 1]
